'''Sarliss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. After a [[Unidentified mission (Sarliss)|mission]] in which three other members of the Alliance were captured, Sarliss became increasingly withdrawn.<ref name="OAA1" />
